#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

const int MD = 998244353;

int gcd_(int a, int b, int &x, int &y) {
    if (b == 0) {
        x = 1; y = 0;
        return a;
    } else {
        int x1, y1;
        int d = gcd_(b, a % b, x1, y1);
        x = y1;
        y = x1 - (a / b) * y1;
        return d;
    }
}

int inv(int a) {
    int x, y;
    gcd_(a, MD, x, y);
    return x < 0 ? x + MD : x;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m, k;
    cin >> n >> m >> k;
    int m_ = inv(m);
    vector<long long> dp(k + 1, 0);
    dp[0] = 1;
    for (int h = 0; h < k; h++) {
        for (int d = k - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
            if (dp[d] != 0) {
                if (d + 1 <= k) {
                    dp[d + 1] = (dp[d + 1] + dp[d] * (n - d)) % MD;
                }
                dp[d] = (dp[d] * d) % MD;
            }
        }
    }
    long long p = 1, ans = 0;
    for (int d = 1; d <= k; d++) {
        p = (p * m_) % MD;
        ans = (ans + dp[d] * p) % MD;
    }
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
